name: What are the key differences between investing in new construction versus existing luxury homes in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between investing in new construction versus existing luxury homes in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: Investing in new construction often means modern amenities, updated building codes, and potentially lower initial maintenance, but may involve longer lead times and higher per-square-foot costs. Existing luxury homes offer immediate occupancy, established neighborhoods, and sometimes more unique architectural character, though they might require renovations. The decision often hinges on your priorities for customization, immediate use, and long-term investment strategy. We can help you compare specific properties in areas like Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach based on your investment goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction offers modern features and lower initial maintenance but longer waits, while existing homes provide immediate occupancy and established character, requiring comparison based on investment goals.
